description: Dimitrios Zorbas and Dnislam Urazayev at Nazarbayev University publish approximately two days of accelerometer observations with 27 annotated train passings. The September 2025 Zenodo deposit provides compressed recordings and a separate indices.txt file under CC BY 4.0. The metadata describe each observation as elapsed time, microseconds and X, Y and Z measurements; the annotation file records train-arrival times at the sensor. These signals can help evaluate train-presence detectors and sensor-observation components within railway simulations. The geographical site, recording dates, acceleration units, sampling frequency and sensor mounting remain unknown from the landing-page description. The small number of passings does not establish performance across railway conditions. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this collection. Only metadata and file names were inspected; no signal processing was performed.
